\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[paperwidth=400pt,paperheight=400pt,textwidth=280pt,textheight=180pt,centering]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}
\newwrite\Aentries
\immediate\openout\Aentries=\jobname.nodes
\newcount\Aformatted
\let\Aformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{\global\advance\Aformatted by1\write\Aentries{ENTRY #1}\Aformat{#1}}
\makeatletter
\let\Askip\dte@skipcolumn
\newcount\Askips
\def\dte@skipcolumn{%
  \global\advance\Askips by1
  \typeout{AUDIT-SKIP \the\Askips;page=\thepage;goal=\the\pagegoal;total=\the\pagetotal;avail=\the\dte@availht;min=\dte@minht}%

  \Askip}
\let\Amin\dte@compute@minht
\def\dte@compute@minht{\Amin\typeout{AUDIT-MIN total=\dte@minht;depth=\the\dte@tempdim}}
\let\Apiece\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{\typeout{AUDIT-PIECE #1;page=\thepage;ht=\the\ht\dte@splitresult;dp=\the\dp\dte@splitresult}\Apiece{#1}}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{AUDIT-FORMATTED \the\Aformatted}\typeout{AUDIT-PIECES \the\dte@piecenum}}
\makeatother
\AddToHook{shipout/before}{}

\renewcommand\topfraction{1}
\renewcommand\textfraction{0}
\renewcommand\floatpagefraction{1}
\setcounter{topnumber}{1}
\setcounter{totalnumber}{1}
\setlength\textfloatsep{20pt}


\makeatletter
\ifcsname dte@check@defer\endcsname
  \let\DGcheck\dte@check@defer
  \def\dte@check@defer{%
    \typeout{DG-DEFER attempt=\the\numexpr\dte@defercount+1\relax;piece=\the\dte@pagecount;tree=\the\dte@tnum}%
    \DGcheck}
\fi
\makeatother


\makeatletter
\newif\ifDGprogresschecked
\let\DGnewpage\newpage
\def\newpage{%
  \ifdte@inenv
    \ifnum\dte@pagecount=0\relax
      \ifnum\dte@piecenum>0\relax
        \ifnum\dte@defercount=0\relax\else
          \errmessage{First committed fragment did not reset deferral}%
        \fi
        \global\DGprogresscheckedtrue
      \fi
    \fi
  \fi
  \DGnewpage}
\let\DGoutput\dte@output@framed
\def\dte@output@framed{%
  \DGoutput
  \ifnum\dte@defercount=0\relax\else
    \errmessage{Completed tree did not reset deferral}%
  \fi}
\AtEndDocument{%
  \ifDGprogresschecked\else
    \errmessage{No first-fragment progress boundary was checked}%
  \fi}
\makeatother
